scope: Manufactured reacting wet free slab with audited liquid-depletion events and resumable cumulative ledgers; no real sludge qualification or full furnace cycle.
graph_semantics: Acyclic declared derivation graph: independent input/constitutive declarations -> stage reconstruction -> fluxes/sources -> accepted time update -> new-time output reconstruction. Physical feedback across time is instantiated anew; no claim that the physical system has no feedback. Expressions are explanatory strings and must never be evaluated.

equations.title: Conservative fixed-domain initialization
equations.expression: f = cells/parent_cells; V0_child = V0_parent/f; N_child = N_parent/f; E_child = E_parent/f. Independently computed nominal-temperature forward energies must enclose parent/child discrepancies within their declared combined bounds. Initial n_child=n_parent and t_child=t_parent; declared parent additional volume and energy errors divide by f, as do parent bulk volume errors. beta is intensive: w_child=beta/V0_child; q is invariant under conservative N/V0 refinement.
domain: Supported fixed domain with 2, 4 or 8 cells; reference volume equals half_thickness_m times reference_face_area_m2 divided by cells.
Forward initialization also uses all constitutive inputs of the stage-storage nodes; the acyclic input node records the conservation constraint, not a standalone energy formula.
omissions: Not an independently refined material measurement.
Arithmetic/source-bound consistency is not a global spatial error estimate.

equations.title: Current geometry from conserved mechanical state
equations.expression: Mechanical state is (n_0,...,n_(cells-1),t), with all stretches positive. V0=A0 H0/cells; dx_i=(H0/cells)n_i; A=A0 t^2; J_i=n_i t^2; V_i=V0 J_i. Initial child normal stretch copies its parent and the common tangent is inherited.
domain: Two, four or eight current cells; common tangent is a reduced kinematic constraint, not pointwise isotropic free traction.
omissions: No prescribed strain history; no general three-dimensional displacement field.

equations.title: Manufactured Shomate solid caloric and incompressible phase
equations.expression: x=T/1000 K; Cp=A+B x+C x^2+D x^3+E/x^2; h0=hf298+1000[A x+B x^2/2+C x^3/3+D x^4/4-E/x+F-H]; u=h0-p_ref v0; h(T,p)=u+p v0; Cv=Cp.
domain: A/B coefficient values, formation energies, phase identity and errors are manufactured case inputs.
The Shomate source documents the polynomial form only; coefficients A-H have the conventional scaled-temperature Shomate units.
omissions: No measured solid phase, phase diagram, thermal expansion or compressibility.

equations.title: Manufactured ideal carrier caloric convention
equations.expression: x=T/1000 K; Cp=A+B x+C x^2+D x^3+E/x^2; h=hf298+1000[A x+B x^2/2+C x^3/3+D x^4/4-E/x+F-H]; u=h-Rmix T; Cv=Cp-Rmix.
domain: Single manufactured carrier called fixture; coefficient range must contain evaluated T.
Source supports Shomate form, not these manufactured carrier values.
omissions: Not a qualified atmospheric gas composition or actual carrier chemistry.

equations.title: Source-qualified water EOS and explicit ideal-vapor bridge
equations.expression: delta=rho/rhoc; tau=Tc/T; p=rho Rspec T(1+delta phi_r,delta); u_mass=Rspec T tau(phi_0,tau+phi_r,tau); h_mass=u_mass+p/rho. Molar energies multiply by Mwater and add the common reference offset. Ideal mixture water uses source ideal h(T), then u_ideal=h_ideal-Rmix T and Cv_ideal=Cp_ideal-Rmix.

Rmix.meaning: mixture molar gas constant, distinct from fitted Rspec times Mwater

sources.locator: Section 2, equations (1)-(3), and Table 3; source EOS constants and thermodynamic derivative relations
Local limited factual extract; NIST gas formation reference and IAPWS facts

domain: Only source-approved provider phases and domains; source and implementation identities checked at evaluation.
No NIST gas fit is extrapolated below 500 K: low-temperature gas caloric uses IAPWS ideal bridge.
Numerical envelope in the case is explicitly manufactured, not a certified EOS uncertainty interval.
omissions: Bridge is ideal-mixture approximation; fitted IAPWS R and Rmix are not silently equated.
No water activity of actual sludge, adsorption, electrolytes or mixture EOS.

equations.title: Manufactured composition-dependent skeleton storage
equations.expression: ell_i=ln(lambda_i); theta=sum ell_i; dev_i=ell_i-theta/3; Eel0=V0[K theta^2/2+G sum dev_i^2]; Es0=gamma Amicro0 lambda_p^2; w_i=beta_i/V0; q=q0+sum w_i N_i; Eel=q Eel0; Es=q Es0; dEel/dN_i=w_i Eel0; dEs/dN_i=w_i Es0.
domain: q0 positive; complete nonnegative weights and inventories; temperature-independent q.
Amicro0=area density times V0; beta/V0 preserves refinement extensivity.
omissions: Manufactured energy function; no material surface calibration.
Composition derivatives are storage derivatives, never additional external power.

equations.title: Planar liquid and ideal-gas pore-volume closure
equations.expression: Vavailable=Vbulk-sum_s Ns vs; Vliquid=Nliquid Mwater/rho_liquid(T,P); Vgas=sum_g Ng Rmix T/P; solve Vliquid+Vgas=Vavailable with Pliquid=Pgas_total.
domain: Positive remaining pore volume; original global pressure domain/bracket guards retained.
Declared solid-volume errors contribute a certified local bound where applicable; root tolerance is not a physical uncertainty measurement.
omissions: No capillary pressure or saturation constraint is imposed by this closure.

equations.title: Conserved total cell energy
equations.expression: Uthermal=sum_s Ns us(T)+Nliquid uliquid(T,P)+sum_g Ng ug(T); E=Uthermal+Eel+Es. Stored uncertainty includes declared caloric/volume bounds, propagated mechanical bounds and arithmetic rounding.

Uthermal.meaning: thermal internal energy including formation reference

domain: All evaluated phase energies share explicit formation/reference convention.
omissions: No separate reaction-heat or latent-heat addition; those changes are already represented by species storage.
Declared parameter uncertainty remains manufactured and is not experimental confidence.

equations.title: Stage temperature reconstructed from conserved state
equations.expression: Given represented stage (N,E,n,t), evaluate temperature-independent recoverable mechanical energy at current N,n,t with zero rates. Set Uthermal_target=E-Eel-Es with target, mechanical and subtraction error bounds; invert thermal storage in the supplied temperature bracket and solve pressure from current available pore volume. No free-rate solve or prescribed motion is used inside this point inversion.
domain: Conditional inverse certification uses the declared positive heat-capacity/envelope assumptions.
omissions: No extrapolation beyond source and case domains; unknown or invalid states fail rather than being clipped.

equations.title: Gas intensives and common face state
equations.expression: ci=Ni/Vgas; c=sum ci; xi=ci/c; Mbar=sum xi Mi; rho=c Mbar; Yi=xi Mi/Mbar; p=c Rmix T. Face T,p,x interpolate with left weight dr/(dl+dr); face composition is normalized. Serial Dface=(dl+dr)/(dl/DL+dr/DR), or zero when either side coefficient is zero.
domain: Current gas pore volume, face area and cell widths are used.
omissions: Spatial interpolation and serial averaging are discrete design choices, not new material data.

equations.title: Mixture-averaged mass-frame diffusion and disabled Darcy branch
equations.expression: jstar_i=-rho_face(Mi/Mbar_face)Dface_i(xR_i-xL_i)/(dl+dr); S=sum jstar_i; j_i=jstar_i-Ydonor_i S; Fdiff_i=A j_i/Mi. Correction donor is left if S<0 and right if S>0. Darcy velocity=-permeability*relative_permeability/viscosity*(pR-pL)/(dl+dr)=0 for this case.

Fdiff_i.meaning: face molar transfer rate, positive left to right

sources.locator: Diffusive Fluxes; mixture-averaged jstar and zero-net-mass correction
Transport source identity and applicability declarations

domain: Constitutive form follows recorded transport source; donor selection for correction is the implementation positivity-oriented discretization.
Zero carrier diffusivity does not force zero corrected carrier flux.
omissions: No Soret, multicomponent Maxwell-Stefan solver or calibrated porous diffusivity.
Darcy branch is disabled; this case does not validate nonzero permeability.

equations.title: Fourier transfer plus common-face-temperature diffusive enthalpy
equations.expression: Qcond=A(TL-TR)/(dl/kL+dr/kR), zero if either conductivity is zero. Hface=Qcond+sum_i Fdiff_i h_i(Tface)+sum_i Fadv_i h_i(Tadv_donor); Fadv=0 in this case.

Hface.meaning: total face energy transfer left to right

h_i.meaning: species molar enthalpy evaluated at specified temperature

Tface.meaning: common interpolated face temperature for diffusion

sources.locator: Governing energy equation and Diffusive Fluxes; enthalpy transport

domain: Each internal face is assembled once with opposite neighboring balance signs.
No external reservoir or imposed surface temperature in the supported case.
omissions: Diffusive enthalpy uses face T, not species donor T.
No radiation, kiln atmosphere convection or calibrated brick conductivity.

equations.title: Manufactured normalized Arrhenius A to B source
equations.expression: r_extent=Vcurrent a exp(-Ea/(Rmix T)) product_i[Ni/(Vcurrent cref)]^order_i; Ssolid=nu r_extent. For Ea=0 and order_A=1, r_extent=(a/cref)NA. The packaged default a=0.1 mol/(m3 s), cref=1 mol/m3 gives r_extent=(0.1/s)NA; active case parameters determine the actual rate.
domain: Artificial element-balanced A to B with current-cell-bulk-volume concentration basis.
The oxygen_free_pyrolysis label is a declared fixture regime, not evidence of real pyrolysis kinetics.
omissions: Ea zero means no Arrhenius temperature sensitivity in this verification case.
No raw-sludge decomposition network or measured reaction-rate parameters.

equations.title: Pure-liquid and ideal-vapor chemical-potential drive
equations.expression: s_v(T,p)=s_v0(T,p0)-Rmix ln(p/p0); mu_v=h_v-T s_v; mu_l=h_l-T s_l; p_eq=p0 exp[(mu_l-mu_v0)/(Rmix T)]. Evaluate liquid at actual total P from storage.

p_eq.meaning: equilibrium ideal-vapor partial pressure for this bridge

sources.locator: Table 3 thermodynamic functions; source liquid entropy/enthalpy
Reference alignment values; ideal-vapor bridge is derived in implementation

domain: Finite positive T and source-approved pure-liquid TP state; explicit common caloric and entropy references.
omissions: Not native EOS saturation pressure equality, Kelvin correction, liquid mixture activity or nucleation law.

equations.title: Manufactured finite-rate interphase transfer
equations.expression: Kcell=Kdensity V0; r=Kcell(p_eq-p_H2O); Sliquid=-r; Svapor=+r; additional energy source=0.
domain: Existing liquid interface and inventories within supported phase-transfer domain.
Reference-volume scaling preserves refinement extensivity.
omissions: Manufactured conductance; no measured drying or pore-interface kinetics.
Latent energy is already in storage and is not added again.

equations.title: Reduced free traction closure with composition-weighted viscosity
equations.expression: eta_i=q_i eta_ref_i; Sni=elastic_Piola_ni+interface_Piola_ni and Sti=elastic_Piola_ti+interface_Piola_ti at zero rates. ndot_i=n_i^2/eta_i*((p_i-pe)t^2-Sni). tdot=t^2*sum_i[V0_i*((p_i-pe)n_i*t-Sti)]/sum_i[V0_i*eta_i]. Actual represented rates are re-evaluated and nonzero residuals and numerical enclosures are retained.
domain: eta_ref>0; q>0 at actual complete nonnegative solid inventories; fixed global reference and one common tangent.
omissions: No inertia or general lateral displacement field; not pointwise free lateral traction in each cell.

equations.title: Fixed-composition skeleton work, dissipation and bulk pressure work
equations.expression: Ri=Sti+eta_i*tdot/t^2-(p_i-pe)n_i*t; C_i=2 V0_i Ri tdot; sum_i C_i=0 within the reported numerical enclosure. Vdot_i=V0_i(t^2 ndot_i+2 n_i t tdot); Pexternal_i=-pe Vdot_i. At fixed composition, Pel_i+Psurface_i+D_i-p_i Vdot_i=Pexternal_i+C_i. Total cell power is Pexternal_i+C_i+Pbody_i. Composition derivatives of Eel+Es enter total storage inversion, not an additional heat source.

D_i.meaning: viscous dissipation retained in mechanical balance

domain: Local constraint work must remain in each cell even when its global sum is enclosed by zero.
omissions: No duplicate viscous, latent, reaction or composition-energy heat source.

equations.title: Conservative inventories and energy on moving cells
equations.expression: dN_cell,i/dt=Fleft_i-Fright_i+Ssolid_i+Sphase_i; dE_cell/dt=Hleft-Hright+Pcell. Conserved variables are extensive: moving volume changes do not add a duplicate concentration-dilution term.

sources.locator: Fluid flow, mass_cons_sp, Lagrangian-coordinate mass balance; Heat flow energy conservation

domain: All internal shared-face terms cancel in global sums; immobile solids/liquid have no intercell face flow here.
omissions: No external firing program, open-boundary kiln gas, full-cycle phase inventory or furnace radiation.

equations.title: Transactional adaptive update with affine liquid-depletion endpoint
equations.expression: For an ordinary panel: y1=y0+h f(y0,t0); y2=(y0+y1+h f(y1,t1))/2. Compare one full panel against two half panels and accept the two-half result if the normalized Richardson indicator is <=1; q=(hleft/h)^3+(hright/h)^3 and indicator=q/(1-q)*normalized(full-twohalf). Use actual representable endpoint durations, positivity/domain gates, and cumulative ledgers. Here y includes mechanical stretches, whose rates share every stage and whose explicit absolute/relative scale enters acceptance. Positive stretch, shape, cumulative mechanical increment and signed quadrature-roundoff checks apply before transactional commit. Near liquid exhaustion, integrate_depletion refines a frozen affine-midpoint terminal path and compares event and common-time N/E/T/P/stretch values plus event time; commit only after terminal and independent approach gates pass. The depletion clock and nonzero binary64 writeback are separately audited. Exact-zero depletion may have no correction. Resume restores the full original cumulative history and budgets; it never merges that history twice.

y0.unit: mol for N; J for E

domain: Manufactured free-slab case with explicit affine_midpoint terminal policy.
Transactional accepted history retains discarded-trial resource costs and cumulative original budgets.
omissions: Local and terminal comparisons are not a global error certificate.
Simultaneous depletion and nucleation are not established by this pathway.
No raw-sludge material qualification or whole firing cycle is implied.

equations.title: Saved accepted-state output reconstruction
equations.expression: Output amounts_mol=Naccepted and internal_energy_j=Eaccepted. At accepted time, reapply current geometry, pressure closure and total-energy inversion to (Naccepted,Eaccepted) to produce temperature_k and pressure_pa, retaining inverse bounds and qualified source identities. Mechanical stretches are retained in the accepted state; geometry and free diagnostics are recomputed at that state, including local constraint powers and rate/residual enclosures.

Eaccepted.meaning: accepted total energy by cell, despite historical internal_energy_j field name

domain: The reconstruction node is a new-time instance of storage formulas; it does not feed an edge back into the stage-time decoder.
Saved result quantities are computed outputs, not measurements.
omissions: No material qualification or source applicability is established merely by a connected provenance graph.

equations.title: Binary64 depletion clock and inventory correction
equations.expression: Preserve represented event time, signed liquid/vapor correction and exact rational residual totals. Zero liquid without correction is valid. Reject corrections outside explicit per-event and cumulative storage, elemental and mass budgets.
domain: Explicit numerical policy; no material constitutive claim.
omissions: Saved integrity records are not signatures or experimental validation.

equations.title: Typed saved depletion history audit
equations.expression: Reconstruct saved typed states, steps, events, correction totals and refinement diagnostics against the actual operator, original state and policies. This audits retained records; unsaved speculative trajectories are not independently rerun.
domain: Explicit numerical policy; no material constitutive claim.
omissions: Saved integrity records are not signatures or experimental validation.
